summary.en: Fresh graduate in Informatics Engineering from Politeknik Negeri Malang (GPA 3.90/4.00) with a 10-month internship at an enterprise software house, spanning microservices backend development, fullstack system migration, and server infrastructure setup and hardening. Fast learner adapting to new stacks, diagnosing and fixing data-critical issues in production systems, and working across roles (backend, frontend, infrastructure) as the team needs. Career focus on Software Engineering with deep interest in System Architecture and DevOps.

Terbiasa beradaptasi cepat ke stack baru, mendiagnosis dan menyelesaikan masalah data-critical pada sistem production, serta bekerja lintas peran (backend, frontend, infrastruktur) sesuai kebutuhan tim. Fokus karir pada Software Engineering dengan minat mendalam di System Architecture dan DevOps.
